    Take a closer look.

    • Finishes. The 100 percent recycled aluminum case is available in two stunning matte finishes. Apple Watch SE 3 shown in Starlight.

    • Health sensors. Apple Watch SE 3 uses innovative sensors — including a heart sensor and wrist temperature sensing — to stay on the pulse of your health.6

    • Motion sensors. A gyroscope, an accelerometer, and GPS work together to track your activity, deliver accurate fitness metrics, and enable safety features.

    Health Tracking

    Let your body do the talking.

    Unlock deeper, more meaningful health insights that are uniquely yours just by wearing your Apple Watch. From sleep score to cycle tracking to daily vitals, Apple Watch SE 3 helps you understand your health, night after night, day after day. And the Health app securely unpacks your health and fitness metrics into a daily snapshot of your long‑term progress.1

    • Know your sleep score.

      Sleep quality is influenced by factors such as sleep duration, bedtime consistency, how often you wake up, and time spent in each sleep stage. Sleep score analyzes these factors every night and provides a classification and a score. You’ll see how the score is calculated, so you can understand the quality of your sleep and learn how to make it more restorative.

    • Get the inside track on your cycle.

      Cycle Tracking is with you through every stage of your menstrual health journey. Log your cycle and get predictions for your period, fertile window, and retrospective ovulation estimates. And find support for perimenopause and menopause.9 Welcome to the new status flow.

    • Track your daily health status in the Vitals app.

      Quickly see your overnight health data right on your wrist — including heart rate, respiratory rate, wrist temperature, and sleep duration — and get notified if your metrics are ever outside your typical range.10

    • Spot signs of sleep apnea.

      Sleep apnea is a condition where people experience repeated interruptions in their regular respiratory pattern during sleep. If untreated, it can lead to increased risk of hypertension, type 2 diabetes, cardiac issues, and more. SE 3 can monitor for breathing disturbances over time and notify you of possible sleep apnea.11

    • Get a pulse check with the Heart Rate app.

      Check your heart rate at any time with the Heart Rate app. And get notifications for a high or low heart rate or an irregular rhythm.12

    • A healthy upgrade to the Health app.

      Tap into the redesigned Health app for deeper, more personal insights into your health. With Health Age, you can see how your key metrics align with your chronological age, just by wearing your watch. The new dynamic Insights tab gives you a full picture of your health, with real-time health and fitness metrics on display. Explore helpful videos and articles tailored to your data. And because it’s your data, it stays private and secure.1

      Coming late 2026.

    Fitness

    Step. Sweat. Strive.

    Make every move count. From running to riding your bike, tennis to tai chi, Apple Watch SE 3 gives you a healthy number of ways to track your workouts. With real‑time metrics, deeper insights into your fitness progress, and personalized encouragement, it will motivate you to hit your goals like never before.

    • Close your Activity rings.

      Track your daily Move, Exercise, and Stand goals with Activity rings. Earn awards and share progress with your community for some friendly competition. And pause or adjust your Activity rings at any time in the Activity app.

    • A more powerful Workout app.

      Set goals for time, distance, or calories and let Apple Watch track your progress and summarize your results. Jump straight to your favorite features, like media, Workout Views, Pacer, and Custom Workouts. Then head to the Fitness app on iPhone to see how far you’ve come.

    • Your Workout Buddy has leveled up.

      Crush your personal record with new data insights on your progress for pace, distance, and workout duration. Enjoy personalized motivation based on your fitness history, now available in Spanish. And you can finally leave your iPhone at home — all you need is Apple Watch with cellular or a Wi-Fi connection.13

    • Move it. Groove it.

      Feel the burn with just the right beats. Let Apple Music pick the perfect playlist based on your workout and music preferences — or choose a playlist or podcast on your own.14

    • So Much to Love

      Easy does it.

      Got a question? Just ask Siri AI, your wearable AI assistant.2 It can dig up the door code you saved in Notes, your driver’s license from Photos, or that Italian restaurant your friend mentioned in Messages. You can even get ideas for post‑workout stretches, healthy recipes, or wellness tips. And Siri is just the beginning. Apple Watch SE 3, smart in more ways than one.

      Siri AI is rolling out in English.
      Usage limits may apply.

    • Revisit conversations in the Siri app.

      Ask Siri a question on your iPhone or any other Apple device synced with iCloud, and pick up where you left off on your Apple Watch. Pin conversations and see the same content, including images, across your devices. Here’s to a little more conversation and a lot more Siri.

    • All the info you want. Always-On display.

      Whether you’re in a meeting or mid-conversation, a quick look is all it takes. See your watch face, Live Activities, notifications, or active apps like Workout — all at a glance. And to bring your display to full brightness, simply raise your wrist. Let there be light.

    • The Smart Stack thinks of it before you do.

      Smart Stack suggestions are smarter than ever, surfacing timely widgets right when you need them. Start a workout, wish your bestie a happy birthday, find where you left your car, adjust your morning alarm before a vacation, or quickly check your balance when you use your transit card.

    • Great battery life.

      On top of all these features, the power‑efficient S10 chip still allows SE 3 to deliver all‑day, 18‑hour battery life.4 And you can charge up in a flash with fast charging.5

    On the Go

    Take your world with you.

    With Apple Watch SE 3, life on the go has never felt so connected. Whether it’s keeping up with friends and family, staying on top of your day, or streaming your favorite podcast, your Apple Watch helps you feel closer to the people, information, and experiences that are most important to you — no matter where life takes you.

    • Stay active and connected.

      With Apple Watch SE 3, you can keep in touch with the people and things that matter most, no matter where you are.15 Superfast 5G cellular capability lets you text, talk, download apps, and stream music or podcasts on the go.16

    • Get to it with gestures.

      Just tap your index finger and thumb together once to select a Smart Stack widget. A double tap answers calls, sends texts, and more, and a wrist flick dismisses notifications and returns to your watch face. It’s single-handedly simple.

    • Your watch is your wallet.

      Pay hands‑free in an instant with Apple Pay anywhere you see the contactless symbol. Or send money to a friend in a flash with Apple Cash.17 You can also use the Wallet app with your eligible transit card, boarding pass, ID, home key, and car key.18 Smart.

    • Ping my iPhone.

      Can’t find your iPhone? Just tap the Ping iPhone icon on your SE 3 to play an audible chirp on your iPhone so you can locate it again. Sounds good.

    • Let Maps lead the way.

      Get turn‑by‑turn navigation on your SE 3 with haptic feedback. Left, right, or arrived — you’ll know exactly where you’re going, without looking at your watch.

    • Find it all faster with the unified Find My app.

      Find Devices, Find People, and Find Items are now streamlined in the Find My app. With the map front and center, you can find everything you need in a single glance.

    • Live Translation for your conversations.

      With Apple Intelligence from your iPhone, Messages automatically translates texts into your preferred language. And voilà, nothing gets lost in translation.19

    Safety

    Your safety is no accident.

    Packed with innovative safety firsts, Apple Watch SE 3 has your back. It’s designed to summon help when you need it most — even if you can’t reach your iPhone.

    Emergency SOS. ASAP.

    Need urgent help? Just press and hold the side button on your Apple Watch SE 3 to try to call emergency services and share your location.3

    Fall Detection at the ready.

    If SE 3 detects that you’ve taken a hard fall, it can automatically help connect you with emergency services, provide dispatchers with your location, and notify loved ones.3

    Crash Detection. Your guardian on the go.

    If you’ve been in a severe car crash, SE 3 can automatically help call emergency services, share your location, and notify your emergency contacts.3

    When you’re out, Check In.

    Your watch can automatically notify someone when you arrive at your destination. And if you’re going for a run after dark, you can start a Check In for the duration of your workout to let your friend know when you’re done.

    Let Backtrack get you back on track.

    Backtrack in the Compass app uses GPS data to automatically create a path of where you’ve been when you’re off the grid. Easily add waypoints for anything of interest, like the trailhead or your campsite.

    Set up your Medical ID.

    In an emergency, first responders are able to quickly access critical medical information — like allergies or medications — directly from your SE 3.

    Apple Watch For Your Kids

    Look Mom, no phone.

    Set up any Apple Watch with cellular for your kids, even if they don’t have their own iPhone. It’s easy to call and text. Know where they are. And find great ways to keep them active. It’s independence for them. And peace of mind for you.

    • Your iPhone manages their Apple Watch.

      Pair a watch for each of your kids with your iPhone. With any Apple Watch GPS + Cellular model, your child gets their own phone number and Apple Account. You can set it up and manage it with the Apple Watch app on your iPhone.20

    • Talk about an easy way to stay connected.

      Kids can make and receive calls and texts with the contacts you approve. They can even place calls and send text messages using just their voice.

    • Set up Find My.

      See everyone’s location using the Find My app. And receive alerts when they arrive at their destination or get home. Parents can also get alerts when their child leaves a location, like school. No playing hooky on your watch.

    • Help kids stay clear of sensitive content.

      Communication Safety helps protect children from viewing or sharing detected nudity in Messages, FaceTime video messages, and more. It now also intervenes when it detects gore or violence in shared images and videos.

    Learn more about Apple Watch For Your Kids

    Apple Watch SE 3 and the environment.

    • Learn more in our Product Environmental Report (PDF)

    • Made with 40% recycled material by weight.

      Recycled Material

      Our approach.

      Using recycled materials, like 100% recycled aluminum in the case, reduces the need to mine new material, which avoids the carbon emissions and environmental impacts of mining.

       Learn more in our Product Environmental Report (PDF)

      How you can help.

      You can protect the earth’s precious resources by trading in, passing down, or recycling devices and accessories you no longer use. You can bring them into any Apple Store for free, secure recycling. We also offer other ways to recycle, including mail-in options.

       Learn how to trade in or recycle devices

    • Manufactured with 100% renewable electricity.

      Renewable Electricity

      Our approach.

      Using electricity from renewable sources like wind and solar across our global supply chain — instead of fossil fuels — significantly reduces carbon emissions from manufacturing Apple products.

       Learn more in our Product Environmental Report (PDF)

      How you can help.

      You can extend the lifespan of your batteries and Apple products by using Optimized Battery Charging. It works by learning your charging habits and delaying the final charge — from 80% to 100% — until you are likely to need it.

       Learn more about Optimized Battery Charging

    • Ships in compact packaging for 40% more units per trip.

      Package and Ship

      Our approach.

      We designed the Apple Watch SE 3 box to be smaller than previous boxes, which reduces carbon emissions from transportation because it weighs less and more units can be shipped per trip.

       Learn more in our Product Environmental Report (PDF)

      How you can help.

      New Apple products come in paper packaging that’s 100% fiber-based. In most places, you can put the entire box into your household recycling bin. You can also bring Apple packaging to any Apple Store and we’ll recycle it for free.

       Learn more about recycling
